title: basananthe hanningtoniana
intro: Basananthe hanningtoniana, commonly known as the Yellow-berried Basananthe, is a plant species in the family Celastraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, particularly in Eastern Africa, where it is valued for its health benefits and therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Basananthe hanningtoniana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its potential health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
